other_failure_modes.name: Target leakage in aggregations and encodings
other_failure_modes.description: The agent computes target-based aggregations (e.g., mean adoption speed per RescuerID, State, or Breed Pair) directly on the training set and maps them back to the training set without out-of-fold (OOF) or leave-one-out techniques. This leaks the target variable of a row into its own features, leading to severe overfitting.

other_failure_modes.name: Overfitting thresholds to validation set
other_failure_modes.description: The agent optimizes decision thresholds on continuous predictions using the validation set, and then reports the performance of these exact optimized thresholds on the same validation set. This leaks validation information into the final metric and biases the reported score upward.

summary: The solution implements a reasonable multiclass LightGBM ensemble for an ordinal regression task, leveraging expected value mapping and thresholding. However, it suffers from two critical forms of data leakage: target aggregations/encodings leak the label into training features, and decision thresholds are tuned and evaluated on the same validation set.
